ev_0005.summary: Circle_01 with centre O=(263.6,238.1) and radius about 196.7 px. Diameter AB is horizontal through O, with A=(66.8,238.0) and B=(460.3,238.0). Chord AC runs from A to C=(390.2,87.5) and crosses the vertical chord DG at the interior point E=(169.0,190.5). Vertical chord DG runs from D=(169.0,65.6) to G=(169.0,410.5) at x=169 and meets AB at the foot F=(169.0,238.0). A verified right-angle mark sits at F between AB and DG. Segment EO joins the interior point E to the centre O. Labels come from the supervisor's verified list and agree with the CV bindings. Segment endpoints were snapped to labelled vertices where the detector overshot by about 4-6 px.

payload.notes: Scale from STYLE METRICS (s=0.017621 cm/px), origin shifted to O with y flipped. Line width 1.0pt with round joins, label font 14.5/17.4 pt per metrics. Circle radius 3.466 cm; AB, DG, AC, EO drawn between GES endpoints. One right-angle square at F (0.264 cm side), dots at O and E, labels at the requested anchors.

Repair v1 with the three low-severity fixes only. (1) Circle stroke set to 1.4pt, heavier than the 1.0pt global width. (2) O dot enlarged from radius 0.05 cm to 0.07 cm (about 2pt). (3) E label placed with TikZ `above left` (label sits above-left of E). Note: a literal `anchor=north west` would put the label below-right of E, so I used `above left` to match the stated intent. The dot at E is removed. Coordinates, segments, right-angle mark, other labels and fonts are unchanged.
